digest.title: Of course the ChatGPT dog cancer vaccine spawned a startup
digest.tldr: Remember that much-hyped story about an Australian tech entrepreneur using ChatGPT, Grok, and other AI tools to craft a personalized cancer vaccine for his dog?  Well, surprise: he's launched a startup.
